title: The Empty Coop
scene: At 7:10 PM, the farm egg crate was emptied. A squall latched the barn door from 6:50 to 7:30.

suspects.name: Otto Hale
suspects.testimony: I was in the milking shed at 7:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The shed camera shows Otto at 7:08 and 7:15.

suspects.name: Bella Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the barn at 7:10, gathering eggs.
suspects.contradiction: The barn door was latched from outside, and eggshell was in Bella's pocket.

suspects.name: Cyrus Pike
suspects.testimony: I was treating a hen in the yard at 7:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The vet log shows Cyrus at 7:06 and 7:18.

suspects.name: Dora Lund
suspects.testimony: I was at the farmhouse kitchen at 7:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The kitchen timer was set by Dora at 7:09.
